name: visibility
description: Represents show/hide state, e.g. password visibility toggles. The eye outline stays intact in both states; on hover the eye blinks shut — the pupil shrinks away as a lash line draws across it.

animation.description: The pupil shrinks to 20 percent and fades (0.18s) while a lash line draws left to right across the eye (0.2s draw ease, 0.08s delay) — a blink shut. The outline never moves, so both states read as the same control. Reopens in reverse unless committed; clicking toggles and holds the hidden state until clicked again. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Pair with the controlled input so screen readers announce actual reveal state.
